item.title: Where extreme heat is having the biggest impact on Americans’ lives, according to a new AP-NORC poll
item.description: A new AP-NORC poll finds that Americans are increasingly noticing the impact of extreme heat on their lives, and they say much of that shift is happening in the West and Midwest.
